title: Yamunāstakam

lyrics.gujarati:
નમામિ યમુનામહં સકલ સિદ્ધિ હેતું મુદા
મુરારિ પદ પંકજ સ્ફુરદમન્દ રેણુત્કટામ્ |
તટસ્થ નવ કાનન પ્રકટમોદ પુષ્પામ્બુના
સુરાસુરસુપૂજિત સ્મરપિતુઃ શ્રિયં બિભ્રતીમ્ ||૧||
lyrics.english:
Namami Yamuna Maham, Sakala Siddhi Hetum Muda.
Murari Pada Pankaja, Sphurad Amanda Renutkatam.
Tatastha Nava Kanana, Prakata Moda Pushpambuna.
Surasura Supujita, Smara Pituh Shriyam Bibhratim. ||1||

translation.english: I bow with joy to great Yamuna, the giver of all spiritual attainments. She carries the radiant dust from the lotus feet of Murari, delights the banks with new flowering groves, and bears the glory of the beloved of the Lord of Smara, worshipped by gods and demons.

lyrics.gujarati:
કલિન્દ ગિરિ મસ્તકે પતદમન્દપૂરોજ્જ્વલા
વિલાસગમનોલ્લસત્પ્રકટગણ્ડ્શૈલોન્નતા |
સઘોષગતિ દન્તુરા સમધિરૂઢદોલોત્તમા
મુકુન્દરતિવર્દ્ધિની જયતિ પદ્મબન્ધોઃ સુતા ||૨||
lyrics.english:
Kalinda Giri Mastake, Patad Amanda Purojjvala.
Vilasa Gamana Ullasat, Prakata Ganda Shailonnata.
Saghosa Gati Dantura, Samadhirudha Dolottama.
Mukundarati Vardhini, Jayati Padmabandhoh Suta. ||2||

translation.english: From the summit of Mount Kalinda she descends with gentle, brilliant waters. Her playful course rises beautifully among the prominent hills; with resounding movement and waves that sway like a great swing, she increases love for Mukunda. Glory to the daughter of the friend of the lotus.

lyrics.gujarati:
ભુવં ભુવનપાવનીમધિગતામનેકસ્વનૈઃ
પ્રિયાભિરિવ સેવિતાં શુકમયૂરહંસાદિભિઃ |
તરંગભુજકંકણ પ્રકટમુક્તિકાવાલુકા-
નિતન્બતટસુન્દરીં નમત કૃષ્ણ્તુર્યપ્રિયામ્ ||૩||
lyrics.english:
Bhuvam Bhuvana Pavanam, Adhigatam Aneka Svanaih.
Priyabhir Iva Sevitam, Shuka Mayura Hamsadibhih.
Taranga Bhuja Kankana, Prakata Muktika Valuka.
Nitamba Tata Sundarim, Namata Krishnaturya Priyam. ||3||

translation.english: She purifies the earth and all the worlds, accompanied by many beautiful sounds and served as though by beloved companions—parrots, peacocks, swans and other birds. Her waves are like armlets and her sands shine like pearls. Bow to beautiful Yamuna, beloved of Krishna.

lyrics.gujarati:
અનન્તગુણ ભૂષિતે શિવવિરંચિદેવસ્તુતે
ઘનાઘનનિભે સદા ધ્રુવપરાશરાભીષ્ટદે |
વિશુદ્ધ મથુરાતટે સકલગોપગોપીવૃતે
કૃપાજલધિસંશ્રિતે મમ મનઃ સુખં ભાવય ||૪||
lyrics.english:
Ananta Guna Bhushite, Shiva Viranchi Deva Stute.
Ghanaghana Nibhe Sada, Dhruva Parashara Bhishtade.
Vishuddha Mathura Tate, Sakala Gopa Gopi Vrite.
Kripa Jaladhi Samshrite, Mama Manah Sukham Bhavaya. ||4||

translation.english: Adorned with infinite virtues and praised by Shiva, Brahma and the gods, she is ever dark like a dense rain cloud and grants the cherished wishes of Dhruva and Parashara. At the pure banks of Mathura, surrounded by cowherds and gopis, she is an ocean of compassion. May my mind find happiness in her.

lyrics.gujarati:
યયા ચરણપદ્મજા મુરરિપોઃ પ્રિયં ભાવુકા
સમાગમનતો ભવત્સકલસિદ્ધિદા સેવતામ્ |
તયા સહશતામિયાત્કમલજા સપત્નીવય-
હરિપ્રિયકલિન્દયા મનસિ મે સદા સ્થીયતામ્ ||૫||
lyrics.english:
Yaya Charana Padmaja, Murari Poh Priyam Bhavuka.
Samagamanato Bhavat, Sakala Siddhida Sevatam.
Taya Sahashatam Iyat, Kamalaja Saptnivaya.
Haripriya Kalindaya, Manasi Me Sada Sthiyatam. ||5||

translation.english: May that Yamuna, whose association with the lotus feet of Murari is most beloved and which grants all attainments to those who serve her, ever remain within my heart. May I attain intimate association with Kalinda, beloved of Hari, who is as dear as the companion of the lotus-born Brahma.

lyrics.gujarati:
નમોસ્તુ યમુને સદા તવ ચરિત્રમત્યદ્ભુતં
ન જાતુ યમયાતના ભવતિ તે પયઃ પાનતઃ |
યમોપિ ભગિનીસુતાન્ કથમુહન્તિ દુષ્ટાનપિ
પ્રિયો ભવતિ સેવનાત્તવ હરેર્યથા ગોપિકાઃ ||૬||
lyrics.english:
Namostu Yamune Sada, Tava Charitram Atyadbhutam.
Na Jatu Yama Yatana, Bhavati Te Payah Panatah.
Yamopi Bhagini Sutan, Katham U Hanti Dushtan Api.
Priyo Bhavati Sevanat, Tava Harer Yatha Gopikah. ||6||

translation.english: Obeisance always to you, Yamuna; your glory is wondrous indeed. One who drinks your sacred waters need never fear the torments of Yama. How could Yama punish even sinful children of his own sister? Through your service, one becomes beloved of Hari just as the gopis became beloved of Him.

lyrics.gujarati:
મમાસ્તુ તવ સન્નિધૌ તનુનવત્વમેતાવતા
ન દુર્લભતમારતિર્મુરરિપૌ મુકુન્દપ્રિયે |
અતોસ્તુ તવ લાલના સુરધુની પરં સુંગમા-
ત્તવૈવ ભુવિ કીર્તિતા ન તુ કદાપિ પુષ્ટિસ્થિતૈઃ ||૭||
lyrics.english:
Mamas tu Tava Sannidhau Tanu Navatvam Etatavata.
Na Durlabhatam Aratir Muraripau Mukundapriye.
Atostu Tava Lalana Suradhuni Param Sangama.
Tavaiva Bhuvi Kirtita Na Tu Kadapi Pushtisthitaih. ||7||

translation.english: May my body and being remain renewed through your presence, O beloved of Mukunda. May loving attachment to Murari never become difficult for me. May the loving grace received from you surpass even that of the celestial river; your glory alone is celebrated upon the earth by those established in divine grace.

lyrics.gujarati:
સ્તુતિ તવ કરોતિ કઃ કમલજાસપત્નિ પ્રિયે
હરેર્યદનુસેવયા ભવતિ સૌખ્યમામોક્ષતઃ |
ઇયં તવ કથાધિકા સકલ ગોપિકા સંગમ-
સ્મરશ્રમજલાણુભિઃ સકલ ગાત્રજૈઃ સંગમઃ ||૮||
lyrics.english:
Stutim Tava Karoti Kah, Kamalaja Saptnipriye.
Harer Yad Anusevaya, Bhavati Saukhyam Amokshatah.
Iyam Tava Kathadhika, Sakala Gopika Sangama.
Smarashrama Jalanu Bhih, Sakala Gatrajaih Sangamah. ||8||

translation.english: Who could adequately praise you, beloved of the lotus-born one's companion? By serving Hari through you, one attains happiness extending even to liberation. Your stories are supremely wonderful, recalling the association of all the gopis and the divine ecstasy of their loving service.

lyrics.gujarati:
તવાષ્ટકમિદં મુદા પઠતિ સૂરસૂતે સદા
સમસ્તદુરિતક્ષયો ભવતિ વૈ મુકુન્દે રતિઃ |
તયા સકલસિદ્ધયો મુરરિપુશ્ચ સન્તુષ્યતિ
સ્વભાવવિજયો ભવેત્ વદતિ વલ્લભઃ શ્રીહરેઃ ||૯||
lyrics.english:
Tavashtakam Idam Muda, Pathati Sura Sute Sada.
Samasta Durita Kshayo, Bhavati Vai Mukunde Ratih.
Taya Sakala Siddhayo, Muraripush Cha Santushyati.
Svabhava Vijayo Bhavet, Vadati Vallabhah Shri Hareh. ||9||

translation.english: Whoever joyfully recites this Yamunashtakam, O daughter of the Sun, experiences the destruction of all sins and develops loving devotion to Mukunda. Through this, all spiritual attainments arise, Murari becomes pleased, and one's worldly nature is overcome. Thus speaks Vallabhacharya.

closing: || ઇતિ શ્રી વલ્લભાચાર્ય વિરચિતં યમુનાષ્ટકં સમ્પૂર્ણમ્ ||
